headline: Two crews, three seats, and a bomb that keeps its word
lede: The merge freeze broke and two ships landed in the same hour: Talk Me Down's D4 rule no longer betrays the printed page after a sibling wire is cut, and Gravel Yard's screen console now takes a third human browser — with the two old bugs that meant online mode never actually ran on a wire fixed on the way.

notes.text: #1708: D4 anchors to the layout — the wire count the page prints stays true even after the NEON sibling is solved; 86% of round-3 bombs were silently flipping to a different answer and striking 2P crews for obeying the manual.

#1705: Gravel Yard joins seat host=digger, joiner#1=truck, joiner#2=console (gate L/R, batch A, jog B); join a crew at /retrogames/gravel-yard?net=host. Two-human crews keep the old law — seat 2 stays the CPU.

The #601 freeze lifted when nightly #43 was cancelled (not red); both PRs re-verified locally on their branch tips (bombcheck 38/38, gravelcheck 99/99 incl. real 3-browser relay netplay) before the rule-5 merges at 6242ff5 and 74fb3be. Nightly #44 now runs on the combined tip.

Vacuous greens cost a whole game mode: Gravel Yard's shipped online gates passed on two empty pads. Gates must show the sim moved — a digger that drove on the wire, a gate cycled from the console seat.
